review_notes:
I read the whole file and the simp attributes in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Parametrized.lean. I also grepped Mathlib for uses of arrowHomEquiv and liftStructEquiv. They are only used inside this file.

The `@[simps!]` on arrowHomEquiv generates `apply_left` and `symm_apply_right`. The hand-written `reassoc (attr := simp)` lemmas cover the remaining components: `.right ≫ fst`, `.right ≫ snd`, `inl ≫ symm.left`, and `inr ≫ symm.left`. Together these give a consistent normal form in which the components of the lifted maps are expressed through `homEquiv`. The right-hand sides are strictly simpler than the left-hand sides, and I found no credible cycle.

The `homEquiv_naturality_*` lemmas in Parametrized.lean are not tagged simp. The proofs here rewrite with them in the `←` direction, but only explicitly, so they don't compete with any simp lemma in this file.

I found no missing canonical simp lemma, wrongly oriented rule, competing rules or unwanted expansion that I could justify with concrete uses. There is a possible but speculative gap: no simp lemma exists for `(liftStructEquiv ..).l`. Nothing in the repo uses it, so I did not report it. I could not run Lean, so I made no claims about simp behaviour.
